checks.name: Home stays clean without drafts and uses Vietnam relative time
Consecutive manual input retains focus; duplicate/invalid never increase accepted codes
Resume shortcut opens the exact document/session/version/codes without a new run
Home inner scroll and focus return from recent detail; footer stays visible
Unknown resume retains request and requires reconciliation, with no blind resend

Tile feedback preserves geometry and footer locked paint
Outbound scanning and resume preserve exact data; two drafts stay separate on a small screen
Logout removes draft shortcuts and protected Back cannot restore them
